name: ProbabilityTheory.tendstoInDistribution_inv_sqrt_mul_sum_sub
type: {Ω Ω' : Type*} → {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} → {mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} → {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} → {P' : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω'} → {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} → {Y : Ω' → ℝ} → [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] → [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P'] → ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw Y (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (ProbabilityTheory.variance (X 0) P).toNNReal) P' → MeasureTheory.MemLp (X 0) 2 P → ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P → (∀ i : ℕ, ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P) → MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution (fun (n : ℕ) ω ↦ (Real.sqrt n)⁻¹ * ((∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, X k ω) - n * MeasureTheory.integral P (X 0))) Filter.atTop Y (fun _ ↦ P) P'
provides: Classical iid scalar central limit theorem for square-integrable observations, with their actual variance, including a degenerate Gaussian limit when the variance is zero.
